name: Callisto
tagline: The most heavily cratered body known — a dead, ancient surface unchanged for four billion years.
history: Callisto never tidally flexed enough to stir its interior, so its surface is a pristine fossil record — saturated with craters and scarred by the immense Valhalla impact basin, whose concentric rings span nearly 4,000 km. Magnetic data hints at a salty subsurface ocean even here, though the moon is geologically dead. Its distance from Jupiter's radiation belts makes it the safest Jovian world for a future crewed outpost — a quiet archive of the early Solar System.
